allow: Bash(diskutil appleRAID update AutoRebuild on disk18)
Bash(awk '/Name: +Time Machine/{f=1} f && /\(Quota|Reserve|Capacity Consumed|Encrypted\)/{print} f && /^\\+-|APFS Volume Disk \\\(Role\\\): +disk19s3/{exit}')
Bash(curl -sk --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w "https://192.168.4.1 via en1 http=%{http_code}\\n" --interface en1 https://192.168.4.1/)

Bash(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 mmffdev.com 'echo "host=$\(hostname\) user=$\(id -un\)"; test -r /usr/local/psa/version && echo "plesk=$\(cat /usr/local/psa/version\)" || echo "plesk version not readable as this user"')

Bash(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 mmffdev-admin 'echo "host=$\(hostname\) user=$\(id -un\)"; test -r /usr/local/psa/version && echo "plesk=$\(cat /usr/local/psa/version\)" || echo "no plesk on this host"; command -v plesk >/dev/null && plesk version 2>/dev/null | head -3')

Bash(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=12 mmffdev-admin 'echo "=== host ==="; hostname; plesk version 2>/dev/null | head -2; echo "=== certificates on the domain ==="; plesk bin certificate -l -domain mmffdev.com 2>&1 | head -20; echo "=== cert assigned to the site ==="; plesk bin site --info mmffdev.com 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "certificate|ssl" ; echo "=== SSL It! / sectigo state ==="; plesk ext sslit --info -domain mmffdev.com 2>&1 | head -20; echo "=== recent sslit / certificate messages in panel log ==="; grep -iE "sslit|certificate|sectigo|renew" /var/log/plesk/panel.log 2>/dev/null | tail -15 | cut -c1-200; echo "=== renewal tasks ==="; grep -iE "sslit|ssl" /var/log/plesk/sched.log 2>/dev/null | tail -5 | cut -c1-160')

Bash(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 mmffdev-admin 'plesk ext sslit --certificate -issue -domain mmffdev.com -registrationEmail cookra@me.com -secure-domain -wildcard -secure-mail -secure-webmail 2>&1')
Bash(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 mmffdev-admin 'plesk ext sslit --certificate -issue -domain mmffdev.com -continue 2>&1')

Bash(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 mmffdev-admin 'echo "== certificate use counts =="; plesk bin certificate --list -domain mmffdev.com 2>&1 | grep -E "PositiveSSL|Lets Encrypt"; echo "== challenge record left in zone? =="; plesk bin dns --info mmffdev.com 2>/dev/null | grep -c _acme-challenge; echo "== server-wide default certificates =="; plesk bin certificate --list -admin 2>&1 | grep -vE "^$|Listing"; plesk bin server_pref --show 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "certificate" | head -4')
Bash(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 mmffdev-admin 'plesk ext sslit --panel-keep-secured -enable 2>&1')
Bash(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 mmffdev-admin 'plesk bin extension --exec letsencrypt cli.php -d mmffdev.com -m cookra@me.com --secure-plesk 2>&1')
Bash(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 mmffdev-admin plesk bin dns --del colorgain.com -a ns2 -ip 87.106.44.201)
